subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with the proposed field names and permission semantics?
rationale: The change is additive, but the fields would be plugin-author API surface and are intended to feed host discovery near app-owned Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after owner and security review
options.body: Use the linked PR path after confirming the manifest field names, metadata shape, docs, and discovery-only permission semantics.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing this public plugin contract.

options.title: Pause until host binding is firmer
options.body: Keep the work draft or reject it for now if the macOS host discovery and trust boundary are not ready to publish.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner and security review
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR path after confirming the manifest field names, metadata shape, docs, and discovery-only permission semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin manifest metadata and adjacent Computer Use history make this the best available owner for the compatibility and host-permission decision.
